describe.description: A single brown equine shown in strict right-facing profile against a plain off-white background. The animal has a slender, donkey-like body with a smooth brown coat that is lighter beige on the underbelly and inner thighs and darker on the back, neck and lower legs. Its head is elongated with a white muzzle around the nostrils and mouth, a dark eye, and two very large upright ears. A short, stiff, spiky dark brown to black mane runs along the top of the neck. The body shows naturalistic musculature and fur texture, with four slender legs ending in light-colored hooves and a thin hanging tail tipped with a tuft of longer dark hair.

describe.description: A slender brown four-legged hoofed mammal shown in full right-facing side profile against a plain off-white background. It has a long barrel body with a slightly dipped back, a long neck, a long narrow head with a pale muzzle, two very long upright ears, a short erect dark bristly crest along the top of the neck, four long slender legs, and a thin hanging tail ending in a dark hair tuft. The coat is medium brown over most of the body, paler whitish on the belly, inner legs, around the eye and on the muzzle.
